cohort: The study included 180 mothers from Kirkuk City, with 90 mothers of children diagnosed with ASD (case group) and 90 mothers of healthy children (control group).
finding: Several risk factors were associated with ASD in children, including child's age and gender, maternal anaemia and threatened abortions, caesarean section, and neonatal jaundice/admission to incubator.
mod_finding: 58.9% of children with autism were born via caesarean section, with 42.2% being elective c/s, and caesarean section (elective c/s) was identified as a significant risk factor for ASD.
